events.description: Creation and rendering of the initial EntropyChart showing horizontal probability segments and vertical information bars.
events.clip_query: An entropy chart showing a stacked horizontal probability distribution at the bottom and vertical information bars rising from each segment.

events.description: Dynamic transition of the probability distribution, showing horizontal segments resizing and vertical bars smoothly scaling in height.
events.clip_query: The horizontal segments of the probability distribution dynamically resize while the vertical bars smoothly change their heights.

events.description: A passing flash highlight effect (FancyCircumscribe) surrounding a specific information bar to draw focus.
events.clip_query: A yellow glowing rectangular outline flashes around one of the vertical bars in the entropy chart.

events.description: Comparison or overlay of a second distribution (cross-entropy state) where bar heights represent -log2(q_i) aligned with p_i widths.
events.clip_query: The vertical bars of the entropy chart adjust to represent a different distribution's information content while maintaining the original segment widths.
